newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens, Westinghouse in power tie.
newsitem.headline: Siemens, Westinghouse in power tie.

text.p: Siemens AG's KWU power-generation unit plans to combine its fossil-fuel power operations in a joint venture with Westinghouse Electric Co., sources said Thursday.
The merger is likely to be completed this year, and the new company will probably be based in the United States, one source said.
A KWU spokesman declined to comment on the merger.
Alfons Graf, head of the Siemens works council and deputy chairman of the supervisory board, confirmed that talks were being held with Westinghouse, as well as with others.
